plugin:A1.why: The headless test client can't select a custom agent.

plugin:A2.why: The headless test client can't select a custom agent.

plugin:N1.why: Ignores hooks in com.github.copilot/hooks/: its bundled Copilot CLI predates Agent Plugins 1.0 support (CLI 1.0.81).

plugin:N2.why: Runs a new-format plugin's root hooks.json, which the spec says to ignore.

plugin:R1.why: Applies no plugin rules, in either format.

plugin:R2.why: Applies no plugin rules, in either format.

plugin:A1.why: Plugin agents can't be selected as a custom agent; they need a .github/agents/*.agent.md stub in the repo.

plugin:A2.why: Plugin agents can't be selected as a custom agent; they need a .github/agents/*.agent.md stub in the repo.
